Doctoral Admissions
Akanksha Bhatnagar completed her PhD in Biology in 2023. Akanksha, who is now a post-doctoral student at the University of Pennsylvania, co-led an interdisciplinary research team at Drexel University that shed light on the novel role of the Tip60 enzyme in genetic disruptions that cause Alzheimer’s disease. Full Story
Where Your Experience Leads.
Now, as never before, liberal arts and sciences are being heard and respected as a conduit for connection, equity, and inclusion. At the heart of our mission is a deep sense of community. The capacity to tackle complex issues requires all of us –with all our diverse experiences and unique perspectives– to come together. Teams take many forms, and building a strong one requires transparency, respect for everyone’s strengths, and the willingness to learn from one another. It requires the fearlessness to break out of predefined roles or disciplinary bounds, forge new partnerships, and work collaboratively to challenge outmoded ways of thinking.
Explore 9 Doctoral Degree Programs
Drexel University is rapidly emerging as a nexus for doctoral research and creative scholarship that advances the forefront of human understanding. For over 30 years, the College has built a program of high-impact, well-funded liberal arts discovery. Here, you will join leaders in your field who are integral to sustaining our intellectual life and expanding Drexel’s institutional reach.
